title: SCA Minhag of the Week 218: "Hakham Matloub Abadi’s Responsum on Prayers for the 9th of Ab- Part 1"

chapters.title: Chacham Matloub Abadi and Magen Baadi
chapters.about: Biography of Chacham Abadi and introduction to his responsa on Tisha B'Av

chapters.title: Reading Eicha Before Arvit
chapters.about: Discussion of the Aleppo custom, Machzor Aram Soba, and reasons for the timing

chapters.title: Haftarah in Mincha on Tisha B'Av
chapters.about: Rambam's ruling, blessings, and the custom of Aleppo and other communities

summary: Mr. Arking discusses Chacham Matloub Abadi's responsa in Magen Baadi regarding the prayers for Tisha B'Av. He explains the rulings on whether the community should read Eicha before Arvit and whether to recite a Haftarah at Mincha on Tisha B'Av.
questions: Should the community read Eicha before or after Arvit on Tisha B'Av?
Where does the custom to read Eicha before Arvit come from?
Should our community recite a Haftarah in Mincha on Tisha B'Av?
What did Rambam rule regarding the Haftarah on public fast days?
